description: Machine-readable source/identity/partition contract for the FQE public-data development experiment, read by ml/data_pipeline/fqe_sources.py. Mirrors the frozen experiment contract (sources, identity, partitions, development_populations); hashes and rules are copied, not re-derived. Paths are relative to the public data root (ml/data/public, ACHERNAR_PUBLIC_DATA_ROOT, or an explicit data_root).

drive_protection.open_mode: read-only; never import Python from the drive; never write next to an NPZ (no splits_for_dataset/create_splits on public NPZs); never run validate_public_data.py
drive_protection.mid_run_check: verify_source() re-checks the mount and every pinned sha256; call it before each trial

stellar_sim_v1.label_definition: sep.flux_radius frac 0.5 subpix 5 on the noiseless pixel-integrated primary, true analytic centre, fixed rmax 24 px, no background/mask (frozen generator_source.py:40-66,252; git blob 477da20a of import_public_imaging.py at 98f6a2b6)

secondary_definitions.measured_hfr_px: same estimator on raw - true background - 500 bias (noisy measurement)

stellar_sim_v1.group_semantics: ancestor family; 3 variants per family share one target

calibration.description: train families whose sha256(group_uid) hex sorts in the lowest 15% (41 of 271 families), chosen from identities only

final_test.reason: final-test entry point disabled pending a separate owner instruction (contract-v1 partitions.test_sealed)

hst_acs_corpus_v1.label_definition: SEP chain on calibrated FLT electrons (SCI,1): DQ/non-finite/ERR<=0 masked, sep.Background 64/3 on a median-filled image, sep.extract 6 sigma with pipeline ERR, minarea 5, deblend 32/0.005, isophotal barycentre, rmax = clip(6a, 6, 16), flux_radius frac 0.5 subpix 5 with mask (frozen generator_source.py:424-516, blob 477da20a; recomputation receipt: max rel diff 5.8e-8 on dev rows)

tier_filter.description: contract-v1 'reference_quality_tier == strict': unmasked at pixel centres inside the aperture; sub-pixel APER_HASMASKED allowed. The stored tier string is strict_unmasked_aperture.

calibration.reason: 6 train exposures are too few independent groups; HST uncertainty is reported raw and exploratory

final_test.reason: final-test entry point disabled pending a separate owner instruction (contract-v1 partitions.test_sealed)

hst_acs_corpus_v1.known_label_issue: camera_id says HST-ACS-WFC-CCD1 but every corpus science_header has CCDCHIP=2; recorded, not corrected (frozen data)

excluded_files.fqe_all_references.npz: 13d6133b42ada94e88e572b33449840e85ba8669e30f95b95c77e38fc0a6f2ca (no registry; 763 test-era rows; not used, never opened)
excluded_files.exposures/*/fqe_diagnostic.npz: split column is always 'test' (importer default); never a partition source, never opened

stellar_fits_pilot.reason: jd5702jpq (NGC104, 2017-03-07) is inside the HST test era and lies within test exposures' footprints (header WCS); same field/instrument; 3/49 strict. Not a development diagnostic and not an independent test; never loaded in development mode.

identity.sample_uid: <source_id>:<run_key> (run_key = the importer's per-row record source_id; equals frame_id for stellar_sim_v1; for hst_acs_corpus_v1 frame_id names the exposure, so it cannot identify a sample)
identity.integer_run_id: never used across sources (317 sim/HST collisions); pointwise batching ignores it; not exposed by the loader
identity.collision_check: mixtures assert disjoint sample_uid, group_uid and frame_uid sets

partitions.train_fit: original train groups minus calibration groups

calibration.stellar_sim_v1: train families whose sha256(group_uid) hex sorts in the lowest 15% (41 of 271 families), chosen from identities only
calibration.hst_acs_corpus_v1: unavailable: 6 train exposures are too few independent groups; HST uncertainty is reported raw and exploratory

partitions.val: original validation groups (model/recipe selection and development reporting)
partitions.test_sealed: original test groups: counted and hashed only; arrays never returned in development mode; final-test entry point disabled pending a separate owner instruction

development_populations.stellar_sim_v1: all val rows (138 rows, 52 families); primary target reference_hfr_px; measured_hfr_px reported as a secondary comparison
development_populations.hst_acs_corpus_v1: strict val rows (159 rows, 3 exposures; 102 from one date); neighbour-contaminated rows reported as a stratum where records allow

mixtures.common_reference_policy: HST aperture policy (half-light radius of the flux inside rmax = clip(6a,6,16) with a SEP background and isophotal centroid). The HST stored target is this quantity. For sim, the auditor measured the HST policy against the stored r24 reference on development rows only: median ratio 0.999, p5 0.981, min 0.952 (Moffat beta<3: p5 0.969). The stored sim reference is used as the proxy for the common reference, with this documented discrepancy; no derived sim targets are created.
mixtures.sampling: source-balanced: each batch draws half from each source's train_fit pool (with replacement within an epoch-free update budget)
known_confounds: 0.5 px systematic centring offset between sources
background-imputed DQ patches in HST crops (median 60 px/crop) absent from sim
limited HFR-range overlap (HST median 0.81 px vs sim 2.01 px)
HST dates/filters cluster strongly; val is 3 exposures
mixtures.interpretation: cross-source results are reported per source; a mixed-arm gain is not evidence of transfer to Canon R50 data
